actor_inputs: Only actual frozen14 visual channels and registered21 body values+validity. No world pose, route, absolute heading, teacher action, clock or target input.
normalization: TRAIN3 only; whole known DEVELOPMENT1 for terminal reporting; fixed last200 checkpoint per condition.
candidate_gate: All3 DEVELOPMENT bearings beat mean/zero. Vision_body standardized6-head error must beat matched vision_only and body_only and each full-input removal. Channel removals diagnose physical versus tyre-temperature dependence; no deployment qualification.
scope: Engineering geometry/self-motion head routing only. Full raw21+validity retained unchanged. Load/tyre/wheel feedback remains required for later grip/brake/pace/flight-motor control; no control-authority head implemented by this experiment.
negative_control: Vision-only training must reproduce same-seed full-body baseline predictions within2e-6 on all four original histories.
hypothesis_provenance: Role-routing hypothesis was motivated by known DEVELOPMENT ablations; this is a diagnostic repeat on known development, not independent final validation. No hyperparameter or checkpoint search.
